verdict.rationale: Twilio documents a genuine bulk operation: a single port-in request can cover up to 1,000 US non-toll-free numbers. Its email product is also described as sending and managing emails 'at scale', which suggests batch sending. Beyond these two narrow cases, the evidence shows no general-purpose bulk or batch API across resources. Missing for 10: a documented general bulk/batch endpoint across products (e.g., bulk messaging, bulk number updates or deletes), details of batch limits and semantics outside port-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
